profile_text.body:
Course Hero describes itself as a study resource platform offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep materials, 24/7 homework help, and tutors. The company says it serves students and educators under the tagline "Own the study hour" and "Get unstuck." It was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Redwood City. The site identifies Course Hero as a Learneo, Inc. business and states that it is not sponsored or endorsed by any college or university.

The company's tracked product is QuillBot, listed under writing and editing with a note of paraphrasing. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other registry facts are recorded for Course Hero.
